episode_title: Building BioMADE: $650M+ in US Chemical Pilot Plants | Dr. Doug Friedman

real_qa.q: What is the current market size of the global chemical industry and which companies dominate it?
real_qa.r: The top 50 chemical companies globally represent $4 trillion of revenue a year. The vast majority of chemicals today that feed into all manufactured products come from the petroleum industry, with China now representing roughly a third of global chemical exports after becoming the largest chemical exporter in the world.
real_qa.requete: global chemical industry market size revenue

real_qa.q: When did the United States stop being a major chemical producer and how did China become the dominant exporter?
real_qa.r: The U.S. stopped being a major chemical producer about 25 years ago. In 1980, the U.S. was the principal leader in chemical manufacturing, but divested while other countries, particularly the Chinese government, invested substantially over the last 25 years to make China by far the largest chemical exporter in the world.
real_qa.requete: when US stopped chemical producer China

real_qa.q: How much federal funding did BioMADE receive to launch and what is the Manufacturing USA program?
real_qa.r: BioMADE started through the Manufacturing USA program with almost $90 million in federal funding over five years in 2020. Manufacturing USA is a federal program, now 17-18 years old, where the federal government identifies manufacturing technology areas of national importance and has established 18 institutes around the country focused on different manufacturing technology areas, with the first one based in Ohio focused on additive manufacturing and 3D printing.
real_qa.requete: BioMADE federal funding Manufacturing USA program

real_qa.q: How much total capital has BioMADE raised for pilot plant infrastructure and in which states are the facilities located?
real_qa.r: BioMADE raised over $650 million for pilot and demonstration scale manufacturing infrastructure. The facilities are currently being built in California, Minnesota, and Iowa, funded through both Congress and state and local government investments.

real_qa.q: How much has the price of steel increased in the last two years for BioMADE's construction projects?
real_qa.r: The price of steel has gone up 45 percent in the last two years, which is a huge challenge for biomanufacturing facility construction. Every day that goes by without orders placed and leads managed compounds this constraint.

guest.bio_context: Dr. Friedman trained as a chemist at UC Berkeley and worked in Washington, D.C. at the National Academy of Sciences developing technology roadmaps for federal agencies including the National Institutes of Health, National Science Foundation, Department of Transportation, Department of Defense, and Department of Homeland Security. He founded the Engineering Biology Research Consortium (EBRC) focused on early-stage innovation in metabolic engineering and manufacturing chemicals using biology, before founding BioMADE in 2020 with Department of Defense backing.
